recipes.title: Add an API route with validation
recipes.summary: Export HTTP methods from src/routes/api, validate params/query/body at the trust boundary, and return stable errors.
recipes.when: A client or service needs JSON rather than HTML.

recipes.title: Add session auth
recipes.summary: Store sessions server-side, rotate the session on login, and protect a route with a guard.
recipes.when: You need login/logout and per-request user identity.

recipes.title: Add Better Auth to an API route
recipes.summary: Mount Better Auth on /api/auth, store users and sessions with Drizzle, and keep secrets in bindings.
recipes.when: The app needs email/password login, sessions, and optional OAuth without building auth primitives from scratch.

recipes.title: Cache loader data and invalidate it
recipes.summary: Opt into loader caching with revalidate/cacheTags, then invalidate by path or tag after a mutation.
recipes.when: A read-heavy page can tolerate a short stale window.

recipes.title: Store files in R2 and metadata in KV
recipes.summary: Read Cloudflare KV/R2 bindings from env, stream uploads to R2, and keep small metadata/index entries in KV.
recipes.when: The app runs on Cloudflare Workers and needs object storage plus a small, fast lookup layer.

recipes.title: Deploy static or edge output
recipes.summary: Prerender static routes or build a fetch-handler bundle, then deploy the generated directory.
recipes.when: You need a CDN/static host or an edge/serverless runtime instead of a Node process.

recipes.title: Use Drizzle with Cloudflare D1
recipes.summary: Define a typed schema, read the D1 binding from env, and run typed queries in an API route.
recipes.when: The app runs on Cloudflare Workers and needs SQLite persistence through a D1 binding.

recipes.title: Add a dynamic route
recipes.summary: Map a URL segment or catch-all to a page, read params in the loader, and validate them.
recipes.when: The URL contains an identifier, slug, or nested path.

recipes.title: Send transactional email with Resend or Postmark
recipes.summary: Keep the provider behind a small server-only interface, read API keys from bindings, and send from a route or action.
recipes.when: The app needs verification, reset, receipt, or notification email and should not hard-code one provider in route code.

recipes.title: Handle a form with a server action
recipes.summary: Validate FormData, mutate on the server, redirect or return a result, and keep no-JS submission working.
recipes.when: A page needs a mutation without a separate JSON API endpoint.

recipes.title: Export request traces to OpenTelemetry
recipes.summary: Wrap requests in an OTel span and turn Ramonyx loader/render/invalidation hooks into child spans.
recipes.when: The app needs traces, span timing, or OTLP export without replacing the framework's hooks and metrics.

recipes.title: Add a page with a loader
recipes.summary: Create a server-rendered page whose data is loaded on each request and embedded in the hydration payload.
recipes.when: The page needs request-time data from a database, API, or environment.

recipes.title: Add Stripe Checkout and webhooks
recipes.summary: Create Checkout Sessions from a server route and verify Stripe webhooks before changing entitlements.
recipes.when: The app needs hosted payments or subscriptions without handling card data itself.

recipes.title: Add Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui
recipes.summary: Compile Tailwind v4 ahead of time, inject the generated CSS, and copy shadcn/ui components with CVA variants.
recipes.when: The app needs utility CSS and a copy-in React component toolkit without adding a runtime CSS dependency.

recipes.title: Test a route in-process
recipes.summary: Exercise the real handler with an in-memory host, assert SSR/API behavior, then add a browser check.
recipes.when: You changed routes, loaders, actions, validation, or security limits.
